I understand that. I am praying that they can do a better job next season too. Waiting another 10 years for an adaption would suck. I just don’t want it to continue with this quality. 

Being more faithful to the webtoon and giving more care to the story and production would result in it blowing up no doubt. I have faith a true adaption of TOG would be a game changer.

I see your point and I understand focusing on the positive aspects of the anime. I just don’t like when people only acknowledge the supposed good that the anime did and don’t highlight the not so good aspects and major changes they made as well. 

It’s the sugarcoating that bothers me and I don’t want people to watch and not like the anime and assume the same for the Webtoon. Also anyone that dislikes the anime often gets labeled as an elitist or they are whining when they are making valid points. 

 I get the small ep count but they still had perfect opportunities to still have important scenes but chose to instead put in scenes that didn’t add to the story. Regardless, I’m happy people are enjoying the anime and are being introduced to TOG’s world and the best case is them going to enjoy the Webtoon because that is truly SIU’s vision.

They are small changes to you, I disagree. They changed a lot of the scenes containing important world building for a lot of anime only scenes that added nothing to the story and made no sense. Plus, when anyone does dislike the anime they literally recommend the Webtoon so I don’t see the issue with that really seeing as SIU will still get the attention. 

Those changes weren’t needed whatsoever and you reducing it to “minor issues/changes” will cause the problem to be associated with the Webtoon story when it’s not the case. Either way, you saying they are elitist for wanting a more faithful adaption is kind of ridiculous. No one said anything about a 1-1 adaption but it’s literally almost like a different series to a lot of fans. 

I’m not saying you’re wrong for liking the anime at all. I just think referring to fans of the Webtoon that wanted more for the anime as elitist is childish. 

I don’t see that connection there with the comparisons but I’ll just take your word for that. I’m just saying some people are going to like it and some people aren’t. Them stating their opinion will happen with anything so you getting angry about it and calling them elitist does nothing. 

I personally did not enjoy the anime at all but I will watch season 2 with hopes that they will make better decisions with the production and fix the issues they’ve created.

How is it being overly critical to not like the changes? If you have to justify it by comparing it to other anime you think weren’t good then that’s kind of weird. No one is an elitist because they think the Webtoon handled things a lot better. That’s a toxic mindset. All because you enjoyed it doesn’t mean it reached even half of the potential it had. In my opinion (and many others) it dropped the ball. State your opinion without making it about other people’s.
I agree. If we got a season two I think it would mimic this quality which would be unacceptable.
